qualification.details: Clinical Research Coordinator (Study Coordinator): Bachelor degree in a relevant subject with 2 years of research experience OR Master's degree in a relevant subject. Staff Nurse: Diploma in Nursing or Midwifery (GNM) or equivalent and registered, or ANM with any state nursing council, or B.Sc Nursing. Pharmacist: Diploma in Pharmacy from a recognized institution/board and should be a registered pharmacist under the Pharmacy Act, 1948.

how_to_apply: Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email.
Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 01-10-2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Delhi Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates should download and read the AIIMS Delhi Jobs 2026 notification PDF carefully to check vacancy details, eligibility, age limit, and application instructions. The notification also includes important dates and selection process details. The direct download link is available in the Important Links section below. Download AIIMS Delhi Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Delhi Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Clinical Research Coordinator (Study Coordinator): Bachelor degree in a relevant subject with 2 years of research experience OR Master's degree in a relevant subject. Staff Nurse: Diploma in Nursing or Midwifery (GNM) or equivalent and registered, or ANM with any state nursing council, or B.Sc Nursing. Pharmacist: Diploma in Pharmacy from a recognized institution/board and should be a registered pharmacist under the Pharmacy Act, 1948.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Delhi Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: Maximum Age Limit: 35 years for all posts. Age relaxation rules will be as per government norms. Candidates should ensure that they meet the prescribed age limit as on the specified cut-off date. You can use our Age Calculator to check your exact age and confirm your eligibility before applying.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 01-10-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the AIIMS Delhi Recruitment 2026 is October 1, 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the AIIMS Delhi recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies announced for the AIIMS Delhi recruitment. These positions are for Clinical Research Coordinator, Staff Nurse, and Pharmacist.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Staff Nurse post?
faq.answer: For the Staff Nurse position, candidates need a Diploma in Nursing or Midwifery (GNM) or equivalent, or ANM with state nursing council registration, or a B.Sc Nursing degree.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the advertised posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the advertised posts at AIIMS Delhi is 35 years. Age relaxation may be applicable as per government rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for these positions?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for these contractual positions will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 30,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for AIIMS Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General, OBC, SC, ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for AIIMS Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is through email. Candidates need to send their complete application along with necessary documents to the specified email address.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the AIIMS Delhi posts?
faq.answer: The selection process typically involves shortlisting of applications, followed by an interview and document verification of the shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q9. Which organization is conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: This recruitment is being conducted by the All India Institute of Medical Sciences Delhi (AIIMS Delhi).

faq.question: Q10. What type of job is this recruitment for?
faq.answer: The positions advertised under this recruitment are on a contractual basis.
